descriptions.text: Simply Scored is a complete system for flawless scoring. Now you can create multiple scored projects or projects with many score lines, like rosettes. Just put place markers at the measurements you need, then score. Instructions included. * Base size is slightly larger than 12" x 12" (30.5 x 30.5 cm) to accommodate 12" x 12" (30.5 x 30.5 cm) cardstock and paper * Base plate has grooves etched every 1/8" (3.2 mm) ; you can choose how far apart you want the score marks to be * Comes with rulers on the top and side: one standard left-to-right ruler and one zero center ruler, marked in 1/8" (3.2 mm) increments * Includes three Place Markers and one Stylus * Includes two storage compartments in the back of the base to hold your scoring tools

images.description: A gray metal crafting tool with vertical ridged surface and measurement rulers along the top and left edges. The tool features an adjustable sliding mechanism at the bottom center and appears to be designed for precise cutting or scoring of paper and cardstock materials.

descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. And it’s dyed with pure color all the way through so there’s no white core. * 24 sheets * 8-1/2" x 11" * Pool Party * Acid free * Lignin free
